body:
## Why

Fleet coverage initiative round 4 remains below the 90% objective. The next slice must prove a real behavioral branch in workbook reconciliation validation, not pad the metric.

## Scope

Add a discriminating regression in `tests/pipeline/test_reconciliation.py` for an uncovered branch in `src/counter_risk/pipeline/run.py`.

## Non-Goals

- Do NOT change CI or workflow configuration.
- Do NOT add trivial getter or import-only tests.

## Tasks

- [ ] Run `pytest tests/pipeline/test_reconciliation.py --cov=src/counter_risk/pipeline/run.py --cov-report=term-missing` and record baseline in the PR body.
- [ ] In `tests/pipeline/test_reconciliation.py`, add a regression rejecting invalid workbook reconciliation totals in `src/counter_risk/pipeline/run.py`, and record deliberate-break plus measured coverage delta in the PR body.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] `pytest tests/pipeline/test_reconciliation.py --cov=src/counter_risk/pipeline/run.py --cov-report=term-missing` exits 0 with measured coverage delta recorded in the PR body.
- [ ] The new regression fails when its selected branch is deliberately broken, then passes after revert; both recorded in the PR body.

## Implementation Notes

Coverage-autopilot round 4; low blast radius only. If measured coverage is already at or above 90%, comment and close without opening a PR.
title: Raise test coverage toward 90% (autopilot round 4, low blast radius only)
